headline_en: Tariffs + $100 oil escalate macro risk ahead of US open
executive_bullets_en: US 12.5% forced labor tariffs hit 60 countries including Korea; Brent crude tops $100 on Middle East escalation with Trump signaling Iran strikes.
MU stands out with Stage2 6/7, RS 100, ACCUMULATION structure and strong AI-driven earnings momentum.
Broad tech faces tariff cost pressure, higher oil input inflation and rate-sensitive multiple compression; watch pre-market reaction at open.
executive_bullets_ko: 미국이 60개국에 12.5% 강제노동 관세 부과, 중동 긴장으로 브렌트유 100달러 돌파. 트럼프 이란 타격 시사.
마이크론(MU)이 Stage2 6점, RS 100점, 집적 구간 구조로 AI 수요 호조를 가장 잘 보여주고 있음.
반도체·빅테크는 관세 비용 상승과 유가 인플레, 금리 압박에 노출. 개장 전 프리마켓 움직임 주시 필요.

market_mood.explanation_en: The 74.8 regime score sits in constructive territory yet SPY and QQQ both fell more than 1% yesterday, pushing the traffic light to yellow. Think of it as a river that looks calm on the surface but has strong undercurrents — you can still fish but you keep one hand on the oar.
market_mood.explanation_ko: 74.8점은 긍정 구간이지만 SPY와 QQQ가 어제 1% 이상 빠지면서 신호등은 노란불입니다. 강바닥은 잔잔해 보이지만 물살이 세니 낚시는 하되 한 손은 노를 잡고 있는 느낌입니다.

big_picture.summary_en: USTR finalized 12.5% forced labor tariffs on roughly 60 trading partners including Korea effective immediately, raising costs across steel, autos and electronics supply chains. Reports indicate Brent crude surged above $100 on Houthi threats and US fighter deployments while Trump signaled consideration of large-scale Iran action; situation remains fluid.
big_picture.summary_ko: USTR가 한국 포함 60개 교역국에 12.5% 강제노동 관세를 즉시 확정해 철강·자동차·전자 공급망 비용이 상승합니다. 후티 위협과 미군 배치로 브렌트유가 100달러를 넘었고 트럼프가 대규모 이란 타격 가능성을 언급한 가운데 상황은 유동적입니다.
big_picture.vix_note_en: VIX sits at 18.70 after rising 12% yesterday. The level still reflects moderate fear rather than panic or complacency.
big_picture.vix_note_ko: VIX가 18.70까지 12% 올랐습니다. 아직 공포 수준은 아니지만 안도하기엔 충분히 경계심이 살아 있는 구간입니다.
big_picture.rates_note_en: 10-year yield at 4.70% adds pressure on growth multiples as higher borrowing costs weigh on long-duration tech names.
big_picture.rates_note_ko: 10년물 국채 금리가 4.70%로 올라가면서 성장주 밸류에이션에 부담이 되고 있습니다.
big_picture.dollar_note_en: The dollar index (DXY) is at 101.44, up 0.30% today. A stronger dollar typically compresses overseas earnings for multinationals and adds headwind to tech exporters.
big_picture.dollar_note_ko: 달러지수(DXY)가 101.44로 0.30% 상승했습니다. 달러 강세는 해외 매출 비중이 큰 기술주의 실적을 압박하는 요인입니다.
big_picture.btc_note_en: Bitcoin is at $65057.35, down 1.58% today and 0.40% over five days. The mild pullback signals slightly reduced risk appetite but no broad flight to safety yet.

sector_analysis.leaders_en: Energy and utilities (CEG, VST) show narrative interest from $100 oil spike but both sit in DOWNTREND or DISTRIBUTION structures — not structural leaders. Volatility (VIX) remains the only clean green macro signal.

sector_analysis.laggards_en: Semiconductors and broad tech (SMH red signal) face tariff cost friction, higher input inflation from oil, and rate pressure; SPY/RSP, credit, rates and sector groups all flashing red.
sector_analysis.laggards_ko: 반도체·빅테크(SMH 적색 신호)는 관세 비용, 유가 인플레, 금리 압박이 동시에 작용하고 있으며 SPY/RSP·크레딧·금리·섹터 그룹 모두 적색입니다.
sector_analysis.rotation_signal_en: Money appears to be rotating toward energy and defensives while exiting rate-sensitive growth names; the red breadth and credit signals reinforce a defensive tilt rather than aggressive sector rotation.
sector_analysis.rotation_signal_ko: 자금이 에너지·방어 섹터로 이동하고 금리 민감 성장주에서 빠져나가는 조짐입니다. 브레드스와 크레딧 신호가 모두 적색이라 공격적 로테이션보다는 방어적 태도가 유효합니다.

issues.title_en: US confirms 12.5% forced labor tariffs on 60 countries
issues.current_state_en: USTR finalized Section 301 forced labor tariffs up to 12.5% on ~60 trading partners including Korea effective immediately; targets supply chain violations.

issues.summary_en: Multiple outlets including BBC and Korean agencies confirmed USTR announcement today; raises costs across steel, autos and electronics supply chains. Reuters-equivalent reporting 2026-07-24.
issues.summary_ko: BBC 등 다수 매체 USTR 발표 확인. 철강·자동차·전자 공급망 비용 상승 직격. 2026-07-24 확인.
issues.source_hint: BBC 2026-07-24 / USTR announcement via multiple outlets
issues.asymmetric_impact_en: TSM: negative (higher component costs, supply friction); NVDA: negative (export compliance burden); MU: negative (memory supply chain tariffs); AAPL: negative (assembly cost pass-through); domestic steel names positive conditional on exemptions.
